_doc: Shared test vectors for app/board.py and static/js/board.js. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2-3. normalize: normalize_board(input) == output. apply: apply_ops(board, ops) == expect (board is already normalized). valid_ops/invalid_ops: validate_op accepts/rejects. serialize: serialize_board(normalize_board(json.loads(input_text))) == output_text.

normalize.name: hand-edited task gets defaults, lenient enum, tag cleanup, bad rank
invalid id becomes auto; empty title dropped before dedupe; duplicates keep first
control characters: single-line vs multi-line fields
non-string strings become empty; numbers not stringified
timestamps: offsets, naive=UTC, date-only, fraction, invalid
due must be a real YYYY-MM-DD
requests: link must be http(s), status lenient, legacy 'done' is not a valid status
notes: bool coercion, color, body keeps tabs and newlines, missing id
clamp exposes a space: trailing whitespace trimmed again ('x'*299 + ' y' -> 299 x's)
tags: the whole leading run of '#' and whitespace is stripped ('# # x' -> 'x')

apply.name: add fills defaults and uses ts for created/updated
add with existing id is a no-op
update of a missing id is a no-op (delete wins)
update clamps long strings and cleans tags
update ts with offset is canonicalized
invalid op inside a replay is skipped
apply does not touch top-level updated_at/updated_by

valid_ops.name: over-long title is clamped, not rejected
non-http link is coerced, not rejected

invalid_ops.name: rank must not be a bool

serialize.name: integral float ranks written as ints; unicode not escaped; trailing newline
